name: Lucioles
source:
"I get it... The one that mattered to me is now gone... At least there are fireflies left with me."

[Translated from [url=https://bigeishe.itch.io/lucioles]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我明白了……对我来说重要的那个现在已经消失了……至少还有萤火虫留在我身边。”

[译自[url=https://bigeishe.itch.io/lucioles]Itch.io[/url]]
